findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed the coffee maker to have soil accumulation on the internal surface. PIC was made aware. PIC cleaned and sanitized the coffee maker. Ensure that food contact surfaces such as the coffee maker are monitored, cleaned, and sanitized at a regular frequency.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: The inspectors observed multiple cardboard boxes of food items stored directly on the floor. Discussed with the PIC and PIC removed the boxes to be stored properly. Ensure that Food boxes are stored at least 6 inches above the floor to avoid any form of contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed an accumulation of soil residue on the shelves of the Pepsi cooler in the lobby. PIC was notified.PIC assured inspectors that soil accumulation will be clean. Ensure that Soil accumulation is clean and non food contact shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue and other debris.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
Inspectors observed the following:
1: The accumulation of the Ice in the large chest freezer preventing it to be sealed properly. 
2: The coving/Trim tile behind the ice machine was observed coming off the wall. 

PIC was made aware. PIC assured inspectors that necessary actions will be taken. Ensure that relevant actions are taken to provide smooth and easily cleanable surfaces.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment:
FIRST REPEAT: Multiple items were observed in the retail coolers to be held past their best by date. CORRECTED- one package of cream cheese (expired 4/25), and 2 cinnamon roll packaged (expired 7/25) were voluntarily removed from service by the person in charge (PIC). 
Other non-TCS items in the retail space were recommended to be removed from service for quality purposes. These items include baked beans (X5), green beans (X2), chicken noodle soup (X2), taco seasoning(X6), gravy mix (X2), Ritz crackers (X2), and Vanilla Wafers (X2). The PIC voluntarily discarded all of the aforementioned items. 
Ensure that unopened temperature for food safety items (TCS) are removed from service after they expire, or used or discarded within 7 days of opening.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A). [P]

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: Inspector observed 2 dead adult cockroaches behind cold holding units in the back of the facility. CORRECTED- Discussion removed the dead roaches, and cleaned the areas where they were seen. PIC stated they will notify their pest control operator to increase frequency. Eliminate conditions that allow for the harborage of pests by removing cardboard from floors and frequent cleaning.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.111 (A)(B) and (D) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (A) Routinely inspecting incoming shipments of FOOD and supplies; (B) Routinely inspecting the PREMISES for evidence of pests; and (D) Eliminating harborage conditions.[C]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Inspector observed an accumulation of food debris in the bottom portion of the prep cooler, as well as the interior of the adjacent cabinet. Ensure nonfood contact surfaces are cleaned at a frequency to prevent the accumulation of debris, and harborage of pests.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed bare wood above the bar hand washing sink. Bare wood is porous, that therefore provides a surface that may harbor the growth and harborage of mold. Ensure bare wood surface is painted by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
Orange juice (x 4, manuf. use-by date of 9/10/24), whipped cream (x6, manuf. use by dates of 6/19/24 and 7/16/24), and shredded mozzarella cheese (x4, manuf. use by date of 10/15/24) were observed in the grocery coolers for sale to customers. CORRECTED- PIC voluntarily discarded the past-date products. Monitor foods expiration dates and discard foods when they are past date.
3-501.18: (A) FOOD shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time criteria. If container or PACKAGE does not bear a date or day or if inappropriately marked with date or day exceeding temperature and time combination. (B) Refrigerated RTE TCS FOOD prepared in FOOD ESTABLISHMENT and dispensed through vending machine shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time. [P]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
The following physical facilities are in need of repair:
1) Raw drywall edge is exposed around the pipe under the handsink. Seal the gap around the pipe to protect the drywall and make the area smooth and nonabsorbent.
2) Caulk on the handsink is cracked and separated from the wall. Recaulk the handsink to the wall so the gap is eliminated.
3) Holes are present on the wall to the left of the 3 compartment sink (where a fold-up shelf had been removed during the previous inspection). Fill the holes.
4) Drywall is damaged on the corner of the wall to the left of the 3 compartment sink (on the passageway between kitchen and storage area). Repair the drywall so it’s smooth and easily cleanable.
5) Bare wood is present around a vent above the kitchen refrigerator. Paint or otherwise seal the bare wood so it is smooth, easily cleanable, and nonabsorbent.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
Bare wood fold-up shelf observed on the wall to the left of the 3 compartment sink. CORRECTED- Shelf was removed. Ensure kitchen surfaces are smooth, easily cleanable, and nonabsorbent.
4-101.11: (A) Materials used for FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES may not allow migration of deleterious substances shall be: (B) Durable, nonabsorbent, and CORROSION-RESISTANT (C) Sufficient in weight and thickness (D) SMOOTH, EASILY CLEANABLE surface (E) Resistant to pitting, chipping, scratching, decomposition, and distortion. [C]

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, & cleaned
findings.comment:
Restroom door off the gaming area is not self-closing. Add a self closer to the door.
6-202.14: Toilet rooms located on PREMISES shall be completely enclosed and provided with tightfitting and self-closing door. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Debris observed behind the ice machine. CORRECTED- PIC swept the area during this inspection.
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. [C]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
Food separated and protected
findings.citation_text:
3-304.11 Mold accumulation was observed in the ice machine. Condensation was dripping off of mold observed on the ceiling under the ice maker. Mold was also observed on the inner surface of the ice maker cover, around the tray beneath the ice maker, and a small amount of mold was observed on the metal baffle in the ice bin. Owner shut off the ice machine to clean and sanitize. Bagged ice is available for use until the machine has been cleaned/sanitized and put back in service.
Food shall only contact surfaces of equipment and utensils that are cleaned and sanitized as specified under Parts 4-6 and 4-7 of the 2017 FDA Food Code.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.citation_text:
3-501.18 Wrapped cheese slices, portions of taco meat, and marinara sauce were without date marks in the storage fridge. Owner was unsure as to when the cheese slices were pulled from the freezer or when the marinara was opened. The portions of taco meat were moved to the fridge the week prior when the freezer in the food service area had to be serviced. All three items were discarded at the time of inspection. All other foods were observed with proper date marks indicating the discard date. Date marking was discussed, and educational handout on date marking was provided.
A food specified in ¶ 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in ¶ 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in ¶ 3501.17(A).

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:
6-501.11 Structural issues were addressed since the pre-opening inspection. The following additional repairs are needed:
1. Edges need to be sealed around the plywood that was painted under the kitchen fridge; and
2. Wood used to fill in the gap around the corner pole in the kitchen restroom needs to be painted and edges need to be sealed to eliminate gaps. 
Physical facilities shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114 Bleach solution in spray bottle labeled sanitizer solution was observed at a concentration less than 100ppm. The label directions show a required concentration of 100ppm. Remainder of solution in spray bottle was discarded, and a new solution in sani-bucket was prepared at 100ppm. 
A chemical sanitizer shall be used in accordance with EPA-registered label use instructions. Maintain solutions at 100ppm per label instructions, and use test strips to verify concentration of bleach solutions.
NOTE: If a spray bottle of sanitizer is maintained, be sure to check the concentration frequently and remake solutions as needed to ensure proper concentration.
findings.citation_text:
4-602.11 Pizza paddle was observed with grease and food debris on it. No pizza service occurred since start of operations today. Pizza paddle was placed at the 3 part sink for ware washing.
Equipment food contact surfaces and utensils used with time/temperature control for safety food shall be cleaned and sanitized throughout the day at least every 4 hours.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.citation_text:
6-202.15 Weather stripping trim along lower left corner of the front door was observed to be loose, and a slight gap was present where light could be seen. Replace the weather stripping to properly seal the door. 
Outer openings of a food establishment shall be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by: (1) Filling or closing holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings; (2) Closed, tight-fitting windows; and (3) Solid, self-closing, tight-fitting doors.

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, & cleaned
findings.citation_text:
6-202.14 & 6-501.19 Door to upstairs toilet room is not self-closing. Provide a self-closer for the upstairs restroom door. 
A toilet room located on the premises shall be completely enclosed and provided with a tight-fitting and self-closing door. Toilet room doors must be kept closed except during cleaning and maintenance operations.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:
6-501.11 Floor by the oven and on the stairs leading to the oven/storage area are in disrepair. Owner was looking into repairing the areas in question, but everything might be getting replaced. Complete repairs by the next routine inspection
Physical facilities shall be maintained in good repair.
